simple-value.title: VENCIMENTO DE MANUTENÇÕES
simple-value.expression: SELECT COUNT(TB2.CODIGO) AS QUINZEMAIS FROM (SELECT TB.CODIGO, (CASE WHEN B.TIPOTEMPO = 'D' THEN DTPREV+B.TEMPO WHEN B.TIPOTEMPO = 'M' THEN ADD_MONTHS(DTPREV,B.TEMPO) WHEN B.TIPOTEMPO = 'A' THEN ADD_MONTHS(DTPREV,B.TEMPO*12) END) AS DATA FROM (SELECT BEM.CODBEM AS CODIGO, MAX(CTR.DTPREV) AS DTPREV FROM AD_ADCADBENS BEM INNER JOIN AD_PRVCTR CTR ON BEM.CODBEM = CTR.CODBEM GROUP BY BEM.CODBEM) TB INNER JOIN AD_ADCADBENS B ON TB.CODIGO = B.CODBEM) TB2 WHERE TB2.DATA - SYSDATE > 15
simple-value.value-expression: Manutenções Vencendo em mais de 15 dias..: $QUINZEMAIS

simple-value.expression: SELECT COUNT(TB2.CODIGO) AS QUINZE FROM (SELECT TB.CODIGO, (CASE WHEN B.TIPOTEMPO = 'D' THEN DTPREV+B.TEMPO WHEN B.TIPOTEMPO = 'M' THEN ADD_MONTHS(DTPREV,B.TEMPO) WHEN B.TIPOTEMPO = 'A' THEN ADD_MONTHS(DTPREV,B.TEMPO*12) END) AS DATA FROM (SELECT BEM.CODBEM AS CODIGO, MAX(CTR.DTPREV) AS DTPREV FROM AD_ADCADBENS BEM INNER JOIN AD_PRVCTR CTR ON BEM.CODBEM = CTR.CODBEM GROUP BY BEM.CODBEM) TB INNER JOIN AD_ADCADBENS B ON TB.CODIGO = B.CODBEM) TB2 WHERE TB2.DATA - SYSDATE <= 15 AND TB2.DATA - SYSDATE > 10

SELECT COUNT(TB2.CODIGO) AS VENCIDAS FROM (SELECT TB.CODIGO, (CASE WHEN B.TIPOTEMPO = 'D' THEN DTPREV+B.TEMPO WHEN B.TIPOTEMPO = 'M' THEN ADD_MONTHS(DTPREV,B.TEMPO) WHEN B.TIPOTEMPO = 'A' THEN ADD_MONTHS(DTPREV,B.TEMPO*12) END) AS DATA FROM (SELECT BEM.CODBEM AS CODIGO, MAX(CTR.DTPREV) AS DTPREV FROM AD_ADCADBENS BEM INNER JOIN AD_PRVCTR CTR ON BEM.CODBEM = CTR.CODBEM GROUP BY BEM.CODBEM) TB INNER JOIN AD_ADCADBENS B ON TB.CODIGO = B.CODBEM) TB2 WHERE TB2.DATA - SYSDATE <= 0
